heading: Environmental and climate justice block grants

tree.heading: Appropriation
tree.text: In addition to amounts otherwise available, there is appropriated to the Administrator for fiscal year 2022, out of any money in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated—

children.text: $2,800,000,000 to remain available until September 30, 2026, to award grants for the activities described in subsection (b); and
$200,000,000 to remain available until September 30, 2026, to provide technical assistance to eligible entities related to grants awarded under this section.

children.heading: In general
children.text: The Administrator shall use amounts made available under subsection (a)(1) to award grants for periods of up to 3 years to eligible entities to carry out activities described in paragraph (2) that benefit disadvantaged communities, as defined by the Administrator.

children.heading: Eligible activities
children.text: An eligible entity may use a grant awarded under this subsection for—

community-led air and other pollution monitoring, prevention, and remediation, and investments in low- and zero-emission and resilient technologies and related infrastructure and workforce development that help reduce greenhouse gas emissions and other air pollutants;
mitigating climate and health risks from urban heat islands, extreme heat, wood heater emissions, and wildfire events;
reducing indoor toxics and indoor air pollution; or
facilitating engagement of disadvantaged communities in State and Federal advisory groups, workshops, rulemakings, and other public processes.

children.heading: Eligible entities
children.text: In this subsection, the term “eligible entity” means—
an Indian tribe, a local government, or an institution of higher education; and
a partnership of community-based nonprofit organizations.

tree.heading: Administrative costs
tree.text: The Administrator shall reserve 7 percent of the amounts made available under subsection (a) for administrative costs to carry out this section.

tree.heading: Definition of greenhouse gas
tree.text: In this section, the term “greenhouse gas” means the air pollutants carbon dioxide, hydrofluorocarbons, methane, nitrous oxide, perfluorocarbons, and sulfur hexafluoride.
